title: Diego López de Ayala (Brussels) to Cardinal Cisneros, 30 August 1516 (AGS Estado leg. 496 fol. 22, DECODE R9954)

steps.what: DECODE record R9954 and its 8 images fetched; page order mapped to AGS 0001-0008.
Tomokiyo spanish2C: same cipher as R10024, key rebuilt there; no reading printed.
Tomokiyo's key figure transcribed to KEY.md and applied to AGS 0002 line 1: 'cerca delos oficios que estan vacos en estos reynos'.
AGS 0002-0006 deciphered line by line; 0002 and 0005 in full, 0003 and 0006 to mid-page, 0004 partly letter by letter.
Real Academia de Toledo Documentos inéditos (1516-1517) searched: no. 36 is a different, clear Ayala letter of the same day; Gayangos 1867 prints Cisneros's side only.

Second image pass at 2x with autocontrast by two agents: AGS 0003 lines 18-26 read; weak lines on 0002, 0004, 0006 re-read; key corrections Phi=m, hook=j, I-sign and looped sign = s, X. = q inside words, H. = Xebres confirmed in context.
Third and fourth targeted passes: every doubtful word cropped at 4x, sign string written out, reading graded H/C/I; 66 items settled, 7 left illegible.
R10024 images: 1867 Simancas decipherment bound in; tried PARES for an analogous copy of R9954 (503 error).
Endorsement read: 'Copiado lo descifrado ... Simancas 14 Ag. 1849'. PARES has no item record; archive.org full text of Cartas de los secretarios (1875) holds the whole letter (XLIX + LIV).
Independent reading compared with the 1875 print: the seven open words settled, about half a dozen other words corrected, otherwise agreement.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's cryptiana key, rebuilt from R10024 and stated by him to be the cipher of this letter, read R9954 unchanged; the 1875 print of the 1849 Simancas decipherment was found only after the reading.
outcome.notes: Read independently (about 98%) before finding the 1875 printed decipherment; the print confirms the reading and settles the last seven words.

prior.where: Gayangos & de la Fuente, Cartas de los secretarios del cardenal Cisneros (1875), cartas XLIX and LIV, from the 1849 Simancas decipherment

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
